---
title: "Former DSAIRM repository and website"
---

This is the former home of the **DSAIRM - Dynamical Systems Approach to Immune Response Modeling** R package.

The package has moved to the repository [https://github.com/andreashandel/DSAIRM/](https://github.com/andreashandel/DSAIRM/).

The `DSAIRM` website can now be found at [https://andreashandel.github.io/DSAIRM/](https://andreashandel.github.io/DSAIRM/).
